user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search answers and features
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content potentially used in training generative AI foundation models
user_agents.scope: Web content for training generative AI models
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited based on user questions or GPT Actions
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Public web content collected for AI model training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for User-agent ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content in response to user-initiated requests in Claude.
user_agents.scope: Websites accessed through user queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for User-agent Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates web content to enhance search result quality and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed for search optimization.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for User-agent Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build search indexes, perform product specific crawls, and for analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot Smartphone
user_agents.purpose: Crawl web pages as a mobile browser for Google Search.
user_agents.scope: Google Search and other products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot Desktop
user_agents.purpose: Crawl web pages as a desktop browser for Google Search.
user_agents.scope: Google Search and other products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images for Google Search and image-related features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search features presenting images.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl videos for video-related features.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News.
user_agents.scope: Google News product including news.google.com and the app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Search testing tools like Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible content and internal R&D.
user_agents.scope: Various product teams; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control training Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.scope: Gemini models, Gemini Apps, Vertex AI API, and Grounding with Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology in Apple's ecosystem and crawls data for generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Webpages and associated resources across the web to power search and contextual AI output.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled data to train Apple's generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; determines how data crawled by Applebot is used.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in the robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to gather, cache, and display information.
user_agents.scope: Content of an app or website shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow to robots.txt; might bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content crawled to enhance relevance, accuracy, and citations in Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for advertising and business products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to train foundation AI models and improve products.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for training foundation AI models or indexing content directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow for meta-externalagent to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users and tasks helping AI navigate websites.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because it performs fetches requested by users.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls host-level content to improve services and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt disallow directives and page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences across Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawl content for search experiences like Alexa, excluding generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt directives and page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information for user queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web fetching on behalf of user requests, excluding generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Automated web crawler providing a copy of the Internet for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: A randomly selected subset sample of the web for public research and analysis.
user_agents.opt_out: Set Disallow: / for User-agent: CCBot in robots.txt or request addition to opt-out registry.
